# DHDO — Digital Home Documentation & Organization

DHDO is a professional Matterport 3D scanning and home inventory service based in Lake Charles,
Louisiana. A division of Bradberry Construction & Design.

## What We Do

We scan residential and commercial properties using Matterport 3D technology to create shareable
digital records. Clients receive a hosted Matterport 3D model, floor plans, still photography, and an
embedded home inventory with items tagged by make, model, serial number and purchase date.

Where an item can be found online, we include a link to that exact product or the closest comparable
one — if it is listed online, we will find it.

**DHDO does not appraise items or assign values.** The link shows what an item is and what it
currently sells for; it is not a valuation, and because listings change or are removed it is a
starting point rather than a settled figure. Formal valuations are the work of a licensed appraiser.

Clients also receive a physical hard drive containing their files, plus a short tutorial on using and
uploading those files themselves.

## Primary Use Cases

- **Insurance documentation**: Pre-loss documentation so policyholders can prove what they owned after
  hurricanes, fires, floods and other disasters. Lake Charles has experienced multiple major hurricanes.
- **Home inventory**: A room-by-room record of a home and its contents for homeowners.
- **Estate planning**: A dated record of a home and its contents to support attorneys, executors and
  advisors. Not an appraisal and not a legal filing.
- **Real estate**: An independent, dated record of a property's condition and contents at the time of
  a transaction.
- **Contractor documentation**: Visual records of work in progress and completed projects.
- **Property management and investment property**: Records for landlords, managers and investors.
- **HOA and neighborhood programs**: Quoted custom every time, based on the scope of the work, the
  location, and the number of homes involved. There is no fixed per-home discount.

## Service Area

Lake Charles, Louisiana and surrounding areas (roughly a 100-mile radius), including Lafayette and
Acadiana. Neighborhoods served include Graywood, Country Club, Maplewood, Moss Lake, Prien Lake,
Contraband Bayou, and Gillis/Carlyss.

## Pricing

Package pricing, hosting terms and add-ons are maintained on one page and change from time to time:
https://www.dhdoscan.com/pricing

Portal hosting is not permanent — Basic includes a set number of months and other packages run on
Annual Record Care. See the pricing page for current terms.

## Turnaround

The on-site visit takes one to three hours depending on the size of the property and the package.
Turnaround depends on what was booked; current figures are on the FAQ:
https://www.dhdoscan.com/faq

## About

DHDO is positioned as the premium, white-glove Matterport documentation and home inventory service in
Southwest Louisiana. Not the cheapest — the best.

DHDO provides property documentation only. It is not insurance, legal, or financial advice, and not an
appraisal, inspection or valuation service. Coverage, valuation and claim decisions rest with the
client's insurer, attorney or advisor.
